description: Use right before connecting or reconnecting one or more MCP servers, or when a connected server starts failing: one call returns, for each exact registry name, the latest daily check (reachable, authentication, check success 7/30 days, response time), declared risk, tool definition size, changes in the last 7 days (tools, schemas, descriptions, authentication, versions, before and after) and whether the servers you list share tool definitions. Facts measured by MCP Station, not a verdict; it does not run any new check or execute tools. To find servers first use search_servers.
name: preflight
title: Check MCP servers before connecting
